[SWS_CM_10523] Silently discarding trigger for unsubscribed triggers
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If the trigger identified according to [SWS_CM_10514] does not have an active sub-
scription because the
Subscribe()
method (see [SWS_CM_00723]) of the specific
Trigger
class of the
ServiceProxy
class has not been called, or the
Unsubscribe
()
method (see [SWS_CM_00810]) of the specific
Trigger
class of the
Service-
Proxy
class has been called, or the
TTL
of the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup mes-
sage (see [SWS_CM_00205]) has expired, then the received trigger shall be silently
discarded (i.e., [SWS_CM_00226], and [SWS_CM_00250] shall
not
be performed).
⌋
